name: backup_zip
description: Backup format v1: a ZIP with one member, ciphermoth_backup.json, deflate-compressed and encrypted with WinZip AES-256 (AE-2, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 with 1000 iterations and a 16-byte salt, as written by pyzipper) under the UTF-8 master password as submitted after whitespace stripping. The JSON is {exported_at, passwords: [{name, kind, username, value, url, totp_secret, description, tags, custom_fields, folder, favorite}]}; releases before v1.4.0 wrote only name, username, value, url, totp_secret, description, tags and favorite. History, trash, attachments, settings and timestamps are not included.
